resources.string: Choose a Google profile for identity continuity. Notification Control still works fully without an account.
This profile never unlocks the Vault and never grants Premium. Local security remains device credential/biometrics.
Google Sign-In is ready in the app but requires the OAuth Web client ID in google_web_client_id before it can be used.
Export or restore the local Vault, rules and reminders as an AES-GCM encrypted file. You choose where Android saves the file, including compatible cloud document providers.
The backup password is not stored by Notification Control and cannot be recovered.
Create an encrypted backup. The password will be required to restore it.
Restoring replaces the current local Vault and automation data after the backup has been decrypted and validated.
